notes.title: Tamerlane 6.2 Announcement
notes.content:
In about a month there will be a big Update. Added Achievements will become achievable, Abilities will be added that greatly impact the gameplay and additional Upgrades will be added for more variety. Also some Attacks will be reworked and the survival mode will change.

[h3]This is planned to be in the next Update:[/h3]

[list]
[*] 13 new Abilities.
[*] 4 new Upgrades.
[*] All current Achievements achievable.
[*] Attacks improved.
[*] Survival Mode improved.
[*] In-Game List of all Build Components added
[/list]
